post.description: Queue EVALUATE_COMPONENT_EXPIRY for AVAILABLE stock in the caller custody whose printed label expiry has been reached. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only; institution accounts require operator verification for the inventory:expiry capability. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays the original server evaluation time. Acceptance is not ledger commitment; poll the command status. Conflicts: COMPONENT_LABEL_NOT_EXPIRED, COMPONENT_EXPIRY_RESERVATION_ACTIVE (cancel the reservation first), COMPONENT_ALREADY_EXPIRED, COMPONENT_EXPIRY_TRANSITION_INVALID, COMPONENT_VERSION_CONFLICT, V2_1_CONTRACT_REQUIRED, V2_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

post.description: Accept a confirmed OCR capture. The receiving custody institution is derived from the authenticated session; raw OCR text and images are not accepted. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key and capture returns the command that key created (202, replayed true), even after the unit was registered or received; the same key with a different capture returns 409 V2_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. ADR-049: a capture that matches an in-transit unit no longer receives its reservation; it returns 409 INBOUND_RECEIPT_REQUIRED. Verify every unit with POST /reservations/{reservationId}/receipt-verifications, then receive the reservation. Receipts accepted here before ADR-049 still replay with their original key.

get.description: SIMULATION_ONLY, institution-scoped V2 projection. ROLE-01/02/03 only. Historical records excluded. Existing V1 reads are preserved separately. Each requests[] row includes urgency (see Urgency: ROUTINE, URGENT or CRITICAL; never null) for the Priority column. requests[] and reservations[] are each capped at 100 independently; use /transfer-summaries for joined reservation rows. ADR-046 (additive): each requests[] row also carries reservation_id, reservation_status (both null without a reservation) and decision_state: AWAITING_DECISION (PENDING with no reservation), RESERVATION_RECORDED (approved; follow reservation_status for custody progress) or the recorded request status otherwise. status remains the ledger request status, which stays PENDING after approval.

post.description: Queue a transfer requisition to another blood bank. Legacy sessions: ROLE-03 to INST_MEDIATRIX. Institution accounts: ROLE-02/ROLE-03 operators with operator verification, any other approved bank as source. destinationInstitutionId must be the caller institution. eventTime and requestTime must be within 300 seconds of the server clock for a new command. Acceptance is not ledger commitment.

UNIT_HISTORY_READ_V1 Blood Unit Transactions read. ROLE-01, ROLE-02 and ROLE-03 only; ROLE-04 and ROLE-05 receive 403. Returns custody events whose acting institution is the caller's institution, newest first by acceptedAt then transactionId (descending), with rows within one event ordered by componentId. limit counts events, not rows, so one event's units are never split across pages. A page is complete for the events it contains; the history is complete only when nextCursor is null. Reads are not cached; refresh by reading the first page again. No server-side search: clients may filter loaded rows locally and export the loaded or filtered rows to the browser-generated SIMULATION_ONLY PDF, stating that it covers the loaded rows. Label values must not be placed in URLs, query strings, logs or analytics.

TRANSFER_SUMMARY_READ_V1. ROLE-01/02/03; ROLE-04/05 receive 403. Same scope as reservation reads: ROLE-03 sees reservations whose linked request is inbound to its institution; ROLE-01/02 see reservations sourced by or inbound to their institution. Newest first by reservedAt then reservationId (descending); rows with no reserve command sort last. limit counts reservations. The list is complete only when nextCursor is null. No server-side search: clients filter loaded rows and the browser PDF covers loaded rows. Facility display names are limited to the source and destination of returned rows.

ACTIVITY_HISTORY_READ_V1 institution audit trail. ROLE-02 only (the assigned audit-reader role), for events its own institution recorded; other roles receive 403. Regulators keep the existing aggregate /audit read, which carries no actor or label detail, and requesters keep their /transfers timeline. Events are all V2 commands acted by the institution plus its off-chain alert acknowledgements; each appears once. Newest first by recordedAt then eventId (descending). limit counts events. Complete only when nextCursor is null. No server-side search: clients may filter loaded rows by activity, actor, references or correlationId and export loaded rows to the browser PDF. No payloads, PINs, credentials, labels or OCR text are returned. ADR-045: the optional contract query parameter negotiates the response. Absent or ACTIVITY_HISTORY_READ_V1 returns the unchanged V1 response, which never contains PRC events. ACTIVITY_HISTORY_READ_V2 additionally returns the institution's own PRC supply coordination events (same ROLE-02 access; no new grants). Any other or repeated value returns 400 ACTIVITY_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED; clients must check policyVersion before parsing.

200.description: Institution activity history page in the negotiated contract

get.description: SYNTHETIC_PRC_SUPPLY_V1. BLOOD_BANK accounts and their ROLE-01/02 operators read their own institution's requests (scope INSTITUTION); the PRC account and its operators read all (scope PRC_ALL). DOH, requester (ROLE-03) and legacy non-account sessions receive 403. Newest submission first (submittedAt, requestId descending); complete only when nextCursor is null. Search is client-side over loaded rows.

post.description: Submit one product line. BLOOD_BANK institution account with a PIN-verified ROLE-02 operator (capability prc-supply:request) only. Same-origin, idempotent (same actor, key and body replay the result; a different body is PRC_SUPPLY_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT) and audited. Recorded synchronously off-chain; no inventory or ledger effect.

Conflicts: PRC_SUPPLY_VERSION_CONFLICT, PRC_SUPPLY_TRANSITION_INVALID, PRC_SUPPLY_REFERENCE_CONFLICT, PRC_SUPPLY_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Same-origin, idempotent, version-checked, audited, off-chain.

get.description: BLOOD_BANK_SUMMARY_V1. ROLE-01/02 for their own institution; ROLE-03/04/05 receive 403.
NETWORK_AVAILABILITY_V1. ROLE-01/02/03 (permission matrix: city-wide aggregate availability). Regulators use their own aggregate reads and receive 403 here.
REQUEST_HISTORY_AGGREGATE_V1. ROLE-01/02 for their own institution. from/to are inclusive Asia/Manila dates, at most 366 days; otherwise 400 REQUEST_HISTORY_RANGE_INVALID.

post.description: OUTBOUND_LABEL_VERIFICATION_V1. Source-custody ROLE-01/02 with a PIN-verified operator (capability transfer:prepare) on an ACTIVE, unprepared reservation at expectedVersion. The scanned set must equal the reserved units exactly. Errors: 400 OUTBOUND_VERIFICATION_INPUT_INVALID / OUTBOUND_LABEL_DUPLICATE; 404 V2_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND (also for another institution); 409 RESERVATION_VERSION_CONFLICT, RESERVATION_TRANSITION_INVALID, OUTBOUND_LABELS_MISMATCH (counts only, never label values), OUTBOUND_VERIFICATION_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; 503 V2_KEYS_UNAVAILABLE. Synchronous off-chain write; the same actor, Idempotency-Key and labels replay the original evidence (replayed true).

INBOUND_RECEIPT_LABEL_VERIFICATION_V1 (ADR-049). The destination institution (ROLE-01/02/03 with a PIN-verified operator) scans every unit of an IN_TRANSIT transfer reservation at expectedVersion. Each scanned Donation No. and OCR-read componentType must match one in-transit unit, and the set must be exact, so one label never covers a reservation. Errors: 400 RECEIPT_VERIFICATION_INPUT_INVALID (including a label without a readable component) / RECEIPT_LABEL_DUPLICATE; 403 AUTH_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN (other roles); 404 V2_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND (any institution other than the destination, including the source); 409 RESERVATION_VERSION_CONFLICT, RESERVATION_TRANSITION_INVALID, RECEIPT_LABELS_MISMATCH (counts only, never label values), RECEIPT_VERIFICATION_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; 503 V2_KEYS_UNAVAILABLE. Synchronous off-chain write that registers no stock; the same actor, Idempotency-Key and labels replay the original evidence (replayed true).

SYNTHETIC_PUBLIC_APPLICATION_V1 (PA-ACCOUNT-03, ADR-048). Unauthenticated public submission for BLOOD_BANK or REQUESTOR; no invitation, account or session. Same-origin only, 16 KiB body limit, persistent per-client and global rate limits. Submission is not registration: it creates no institution, login, operator, role, Fabric identity, peer or stock ownership. PRC review, approval and separate activation still apply. Same Idempotency-Key, body and password replays the original submission result (status SUBMITTED, version 1, replayed true) even after PRC has acted; read current status through the applicant session; a different body is ONB_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Errors: ONB_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED, ONB_CATEGORY_UNSUPPORTED, ONB_APPLICATION_INVALID (details), ONB_SAMPLE_UNKNOWN, ONB_SAMPLE_CATEGORY_MISMATCH, ONB_SAMPLE_METADATA_MISMATCH (400); ONB_SAMPLE_UNAVAILABLE, ONB_SAMPLE_STALE, ONB_SAMPLE_IDENTITY_RESERVED, ONB_DUPLICATE_APPLICATION, ONB_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (409); ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN (403); ONB_PUBLIC_RATE_LIMITED (429 with Retry-After).

post.description: Non-destructive deletion (ADR-048). PRC reviewer, PIN-verified, idempotent and audited. Only an onboarded BLOOD_BANK/REQUESTOR institution that is already SUSPENDED. Refused with ONB_RETAINED_OBLIGATIONS_BLOCK_DEREGISTRATION while it holds non-terminal custody (any component not RELEASED, COMPROMISED or EXPIRED), open PRC supply requests, pending commands, transfers or reservations; ONB_DEREGISTRATION_NOT_SUPPORTED for policy-defined institutions. Sets DEREGISTERED (terminal; reactivate is refused), retires its primary account and operators, revokes sessions/grants and releases its sample claim. Domain and ledger history, audit and references remain; the facility profile purges 30 days later. A later registration of the same sample is a new application, institution, login (-i<n>) and credentials.

OperatorVerification.name: Operator-Verification
OperatorVerification.description: Two-minute, session/operator/institution/action/body/idempotency-bound grant. A consumed grant accepts only matching retries while the session remains valid.

ComponentTypeV21.description: The additive V2.1 component vocabulary. CRYOPRECIPITATE is rejected by V2.

bloodTypeEvidence.description: OCR_LABEL only for new captures since 2026-10-17 (J5): BAG_TYPE and OPERATOR_CONFIRMED were never defined by INBOUND_OCR_V1 and are refused with 400 INBOUND_OCR_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. A retry of a capture accepted earlier with them still replays. Chaincode and the database keep the wider set for those records.

componentEvidence.description: OCR_LABEL only for new captures since 2026-10-17 (J5): BAG_TYPE and OPERATOR_CONFIRMED were never defined by INBOUND_OCR_V1 and are refused with 400 INBOUND_OCR_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. A retry of a capture accepted earlier with them still replays. Chaincode and the database keep the wider set for those records.

LocalReleaseRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /local-releases. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only. V2.1 allows CRYO. The server freezes globally eligible FEFO members and current versions; canonical chaincode validates them before acceptance. No local-release detail read is exposed.

ReconciliationRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /reconciliation. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only.

ReservationActionRequest.description: The endpoint enforces an exact body by action: prepare requires preparedAt, preparedEvidenceDigest and preparedEvidenceId; compromise requires reasonCode; receive accepts the base fields, or the base fields plus receiptEvidenceId and receiptEvidenceDigest together (ADR-049); all other actions accept only the base fields.

reasonCode.description: compromise only; SYNTHETIC_COMPROMISE_REASONS_V1. Unlisted codes return 400 COMPROMISE_REASON_INVALID before queuing.

receiptEvidenceId.description: receive only (ADR-049). evidenceId from POST /reservations/{reservationId}/receipt-verifications for the same reservation, expectedVersion and receiving institution; otherwise 409 RECEIPT_EVIDENCE_INVALID. Required for a blood-bank (ROLE-01/02) destination, which otherwise gets 409 RECEIPT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; optional for a requester (ROLE-03). Bound off-chain; never sent to the ledger.

receiptEvidenceDigest.description: receive only (ADR-049). evidenceDigest returned with receiptEvidenceId.

actionCapabilities.description: UI action visibility only. Server requires a bound PIN grant and validates roles, scope and versions.

invitationSecret.description: Returned once on issuance. Idempotent retry returns null; issue a new invitation if private delivery failed.

safeExplanation.description: Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.
Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.
Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.

details.description: Validation failures only: safe field paths and rule names (REQUIRED, UNSUPPORTED_FIELD, PATTERN, ENUM, MUST_BE_TRUE, DATE_INVALID, EXPIRED, TOO_FAR, LENGTH, DOMAIN_MISMATCH, ARRAY_INVALID, DUPLICATE, FIXTURE_REQUIRED, OBJECT_REQUIRED, SAMPLE_IDENTITY_CHANGED). Submitted values are never echoed.

ComponentProjection.description: Actual operational V2.1 component projection. V2 list reads omit CRYO. Purpose is read from reservation detail. institutionId is the current custodian. labelIdentity carries the recorded printed-label Donation No. for display only (LABEL_IDENTITY_READ_V1); componentId remains the record, navigation and command key. Encrypted Donation No. material (ciphertext, nonce, auth tag, key version, lookup HMAC) is never returned.

expiryState.description: Read-time comparison of the printed label expiry with the server clock and ledger status; it never changes inventoryStatus. LABEL_EXPIRED_PENDING_EVALUATION is AVAILABLE or RESERVED stock whose label expiry is at or before now; EXPIRED is ledger-evaluated; LABEL_EXPIRED_NOT_IN_INVENTORY covers other statuses past label expiry.

ExpiryEvaluationRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /components/{componentId}/expiry. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only. The server sets evaluationTime and eventTime; expectedVersion is the inventoryVersion that was read.

SourceSurplusView.description: TP-JOP-D07 read-only V5 source surplus per series: floor(forecast-eligible available stock - V5 point forecast - safety allowance - minimum reserve), never below zero. Explanation only.

RpsPriorityView.description: TP-JOP-D07 read-only RPS ranking of this supplier's PENDING requests for one series (INTERVIEW_DERIVED_OPTIMIZATION_V2). Explanation only; it never approves or reserves.

BroaRedistributionView.description: TP-JOP-D07 read-only BROA ranking for one series, gated by today's V5 source surplus. Candidates follow SYNTHETIC_BROA_CANDIDATES_V1 (pending needs for the series; synthetic distances). automaticApproval is always false.

LabelIdentity.description: LABEL_IDENTITY_READ_V1 display identity. Returned only to ROLE-01, ROLE-02 and ROLE-03: on GET /components and GET /components/{componentId} for components the caller's institution currently holds, and on GET /unit-history for units in the caller's institution's own ledger-committed custody events or currently held; ROLE-04/ROLE-05, reservation, transfer, census, report, audit and ledger reads do not carry it. The server decrypts the recorded Donation No. and returns it exactly as recorded for its issuer (prefixes, separators and leading zeros preserved; never reformatted). Synthetic Mediatrix labels use MMYY-MM-NNNN; other issuers use their enabled issuer policy format. One donation can yield several components that share the value: they differ by componentType and keep distinct componentId values, and the value is unique only together with issuerInstitutionId. The value is not an ISBT 128 identifier claim, is not a mutation key, and is not accepted as a server-side query filter. Clients may filter the already-authorized list locally and include it in the browser-generated SIMULATION_ONLY inventory PDF; they must not place it in URLs, query strings, logs or analytics.

value.description: Exact recorded printed-label Donation No. when status is AVAILABLE; null otherwise. Never derived from componentId, donationId, row order or fixtures.

source.description: CONFIRMED_OCR_CAPTURE for INBOUND_OCR_V1 captures; LEGACY_REGISTRATION for components registered before OCR-only intake. Null when unavailable.

unavailableReason.description: NOT_RECORDED: no encrypted Donation No. exists for this component. TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: keys, key version, decryption or the sealed read failed; no diagnostic detail is exposed. NOT_COMMITTED (GET /unit-history only): the event is not ledger-committed and the caller's institution does not hold the unit. Null when AVAILABLE.

UnitHistoryRow.description: UNIT_HISTORY_READ_V1 row: one custody event (durable V2 command) for one unit. Events from several units share transactionId; rowId is the stable row key. Rows come only from app.v2_commands, the single record behind the command timeline and audit reads, so one event never yields duplicate rows. Mockup columns: Time=eventTime, Type=direction, Scan ID=scanId, Transaction ID=transactionId, Unit ID=labelIdentity (componentId for navigation), Blood=bloodType+componentType, Method=method, Status=eventStatus, Blockchain ID=ledger.transactionId.

rowId.description: `{transactionId}:{componentId}`, or `{transactionId}:UNAVAILABLE` when unit membership is not recorded. Stable across reads.

eventType.description: INBOUND_REGISTERED: REGISTER_INBOUND_COMPONENT (confirmed OCR) or legacy REGISTER_COMPONENT. TRANSFER_RECEIVED: RECEIVE_RESERVATION, or RECEIVE_INBOUND_COMPONENT (receipt matched by an OCR capture). TRANSFER_DISPATCHED: DISPATCH_RESERVATION. LOCAL_RELEASE_COMPLETED: COMPLETE_LOCAL_RELEASE. Reservation, preparation, transit, cancellation, holds, expiry, compromise, approvals and administration are excluded.

direction.description: Relative to the caller's institution, which is always the acting custody party: registrations and receipts are INBOUND, dispatches and local releases OUTBOUND.

eventTime.description: UTC business event time recorded on the command and submitted to the ledger (within the five-minute server window, or the frozen time of an approved population run). Display in Asia/Manila. Null for legacy commands that recorded none; it is never replaced by another timestamp.

acceptedAt.description: UTC time the server durably accepted the command. Used for ordering.

transactionId.description: Business transaction ID: the durable V2 command that recorded the event. One command is one custody event and at most one ledger transaction; there is no separate transaction table to reference. Not a scan ID or a ledger transaction ID.

scanId.description: Confirmed inbound OCR capture ID (INCAP_) when the event came from a scan; null for web commands and legacy registrations.

method.description: OCR: confirmed INBOUND_OCR_V1 capture. WEB_COMMAND: authenticated Requests & Transfers action without a scan. Null: legacy registration that recorded no method.

links.description: Technical references for navigation; null when the event has none.

eventStatus.description: CONFIRMED only for COMMITTED commands. PENDING covers QUEUED, SUBMITTING and RETRY_WAIT. Only CONFIRMED represents completed inventory movement.

transactionId.description: Actual Fabric transaction ID for this event's command; null when NOT_COMMITTED. Never generated for presentation.

unitMembership.description: Reservation events take their units from the committed RESERVE_COMPONENTS/RESERVE_LOCAL_RELEASE selectedComponentIds snapshot (reallocation is disabled). UNAVAILABLE when that snapshot is missing; the row then has null unit fields.

componentId.description: Opaque component ID for row navigation and detail links.

unitAttributesSource.description: Blood and component type are fixed at registration. LEDGER_PROJECTION: read from the committed component by componentId. PENDING_COMMAND: the confirmed capture values of a registration that is not yet committed. Null when unknown.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when this page completes the history.

Urgency.description: Recorded transfer-request urgency (Priority column). NOT NULL on every V2 transfer request and validated against this enum at submission; there is no EMERGENCY alias. It is not the RPS score or a BROA rank.

ReservationStatus.description: Reservation (custody workflow) status from the V2.1 projection. Distinct from requestStatus and command processing status.

TransferSummaryRow.description: TRANSFER_SUMMARY_READ_V1 row: one reservation (custody workflow). Transfers table columns: Transfer ID=reservationId (purpose TRANSFER), Blood Type=bloodType+componentType, Units=units, From=source, To=destination, Status=status. Row selection and versioned custody actions use reservationId and version. A transfer request has at most one reservation (unique index), so a request is never split across rows.

purpose.description: LOCAL_RELEASE rows are kept in this list so retained releases stay reachable; show them as Local release.

transferId.description: The linked transfer request ID (Request ID). Null for LOCAL_RELEASE.

requestStatus.description: Status of the linked transfer request; null for LOCAL_RELEASE or a missing request.

urgency.description: Linked request urgency; null for LOCAL_RELEASE or a missing request.

productAvailability.description: TRANSFER: from the linked request. LOCAL_RELEASE: from its committed RESERVE_LOCAL_RELEASE command. UNAVAILABLE when that record is missing; nothing is inferred.

requested.description: Requested quantity: the transfer request quantity, or the local-release quantity.

allocated.description: Units in the committed reservation selectedComponentIds snapshot (reallocation is disabled).

currentStatus.description: Current inventory status counts of the allocated units, for example {"RESERVED":2} or {"RECEIVED":1}. Units are counted by their current projection; a count is not a dispatch or receipt claim unless that status is shown.

destinationApplicability.description: NOT_APPLICABLE for LOCAL_RELEASE, which has no hospital destination.

reservedAt.description: UTC acceptance time of the committed reserve command; null when missing.

ActivityHistoryRow.description: ACTIVITY_HISTORY_READ_V1 row: one independent event, either a durable V2 command or an off-chain alert acknowledgement. Activity History columns: Date & Time=eventTime, Activity=activityCode, User / Source=actor, Scan ID=links.scanId, Request ID=links.transferId, Transfer ID=links.reservationId when links.reservationPurpose is TRANSFER, Blockchain ID=ledger.transactionId, Status=eventStatus. Events sharing a ledger transaction or business reference stay separate rows.

eventId.description: CMD_ command ID, or IDEM_ idempotency key for an off-chain acknowledgement. Stable row key.

activityCode.description: V2 command operation (SUBMIT_TRANSFER, RESERVE_COMPONENTS, RESERVE_LOCAL_RELEASE, PREPARE_RESERVATION, DISPATCH_RESERVATION, START_RESERVATION_TRANSIT, RECEIVE_RESERVATION, REGISTER_INBOUND_COMPONENT, RECEIVE_INBOUND_COMPONENT, COMPLETE_LOCAL_RELEASE, CANCEL_RESERVATION, COMPROMISE_RESERVATION, PLACE_RECONCILIATION_HOLD, RESOLVE_RECONCILIATION_HOLD, EVALUATE_COMPONENT_EXPIRY, REGISTER_COMPONENT), or ALERT_ACKNOWLEDGED_OFF_CHAIN. Display labels belong to the client.

eventTime.description: UTC. Command events: the business event time recorded on the command and submitted to the ledger. Acknowledgements: the server acknowledgement time. Null when a legacy command recorded none; never replaced by another time.

recordedAt.description: UTC server time the event was durably recorded (command acceptance or acknowledgement). Used for ordering.

kind.description: VERIFIED_OPERATOR: an institution operator that passed operator verification for the command. INSTITUTION_ACCOUNT: the shared institution account. USER_ACCOUNT: an individual synthetic application account. UNKNOWN: the recorded actor has no account row. No SYSTEM actor writes these events.

reference.description: Opaque recorded actor ID (USR_...). Not an employee ID.

displayName.description: Recorded application_users.display_name, which the database constrains to synthetic 'Synthetic ...' values. Null for UNKNOWN.

currentRoleId.description: The actor's role at read time, not proof of the role held at the event.

scanId.description: Confirmed inbound OCR capture ID (INCAP_) for REGISTER_INBOUND_COMPONENT and RECEIVE_INBOUND_COMPONENT; null otherwise.

transferId.description: Transfer request ID (TRF_; Request ID column) recorded on the command or linked through its reservation. Same wire meaning as transferId in /transfer-summaries and /unit-history.

reservationId.description: Reservation the command references. Shown as Transfer ID only when reservationPurpose is TRANSFER.

componentIds.description: Units the event references: its componentId, its selectedComponentIds, or the committed reservation snapshot for reservation actions. Empty when none.

eventStatus.description: CONFIRMED only for COMMITTED commands. OFF_CHAIN_RECORDED for acknowledgements, which never go to the ledger and are not pending synchronization.

processingStatus.description: Raw command status; null for acknowledgements.

correlationId.description: Technical provenance; not a business ID.

PrcSupplyRequest.description: SYNTHETIC_PRC_SUPPLY_V1 (PA-DEF-06, ADR-044) off-chain PRC supply coordination record: one product line per request, never an inventory, receipt or ledger event. PRC Supply table columns: Request ID=requestId, Product=bloodType+componentType, Units=requestedQuantity (or fulfilledQuantity of requestedQuantity), Required By=requiredBy, PRC Reference=prcReference, Status=status.

fulfilledQuantity.description: Recorded by PRC at fulfilment, 1..requestedQuantity; less than requested means partly fulfilled. Null before fulfilment. Not a receipt or stock claim.

requiredBy.description: UTC deadline set at submission (1 hour to 30 days ahead); display in Asia/Manila. Not editable.

status.description: Coordination status only, separate from command, reservation and stock status. FULFILLED, DECLINED and CANCELLED are terminal.

prcReference.description: Entered by the synthetic PRC operator on acknowledgement; unique. Null means awaiting PRC acknowledgement (or declined before acknowledgement). Never generated.

closedAt.description: Time of fulfilment, decline or cancellation.

ledger.description: Off-chain record; never pending ledger synchronization.

history.description: Audited actions on this request, oldest first. Actor display names are DB-constrained synthetic values.

replayed.description: True when the same actor, Idempotency-Key and body returned the originally recorded result.

PrcSupplySubmission.description: Exact body. No free-text note is accepted in V1.

requiredBy.description: 1 hour to 30 days after the server clock at submission, else PRC_SUPPLY_REQUIRED_BY_OUT_OF_WINDOW.

PrcSupplyAction.description: Exact body per action. cancel: expectedVersion, correlationId. acknowledge: + prcReference. fulfil: + fulfilledQuantity (1..requestedQuantity). decline: + reasonCode.

ActivityHistoryRowV2.description: ACTIVITY_HISTORY_READ_V2 row (ADR-045). Every V1 field with the same meaning, plus actor.institutionId, links.prcSupplyRequestId and coordination. PRC_SUPPLY_COORDINATION rows are the requesting institution's audited PRC supply actions (including PRC's responses on its requests): off-chain (eventStatus OFF_CHAIN_RECORDED, processingStatus null, ledger NOT_APPLICABLE) with every non-PRC link null and componentIds empty. The eight Activity History columns are unchanged; a PRC row shows its PRC request link in the Activity cell or detail.

eventId.description: CMD_ command ID, or IDEM_ idempotency key for an off-chain acknowledgement. Stable row key.

activityCode.description: V2 command operation (SUBMIT_TRANSFER, RESERVE_COMPONENTS, RESERVE_LOCAL_RELEASE, PREPARE_RESERVATION, DISPATCH_RESERVATION, START_RESERVATION_TRANSIT, RECEIVE_RESERVATION, REGISTER_INBOUND_COMPONENT, RECEIVE_INBOUND_COMPONENT, COMPLETE_LOCAL_RELEASE, CANCEL_RESERVATION, COMPROMISE_RESERVATION, PLACE_RECONCILIATION_HOLD, RESOLVE_RECONCILIATION_HOLD, EVALUATE_COMPONENT_EXPIRY, REGISTER_COMPONENT), or ALERT_ACKNOWLEDGED_OFF_CHAIN. Display labels belong to the client. V2 adds PRC_SUPPLY_SUBMIT, PRC_SUPPLY_CANCEL, PRC_SUPPLY_ACKNOWLEDGE, PRC_SUPPLY_FULFIL and PRC_SUPPLY_DECLINE for PRC_SUPPLY_COORDINATION rows.

eventTime.description: UTC. Command events: the business event time recorded on the command and submitted to the ledger. Acknowledgements: the server acknowledgement time. Null when a legacy command recorded none; never replaced by another time.

eventTimeSource.description: PRC_COORDINATION_RECORDED_AT: the server time the PRC action was audited (milliseconds preserved).

recordedAt.description: UTC server time the event was durably recorded (command acceptance or acknowledgement). Used for ordering.

kind.description: VERIFIED_OPERATOR: an institution operator that passed operator verification for the command. INSTITUTION_ACCOUNT: the shared institution account. USER_ACCOUNT: an individual synthetic application account. UNKNOWN: the recorded actor has no account row. No SYSTEM actor writes these events.

reference.description: Opaque recorded actor ID (USR_...). Not an employee ID.

displayName.description: Recorded application_users.display_name, which the database constrains to synthetic 'Synthetic ...' values. Null for UNKNOWN.

currentRoleId.description: The actor's role at read time, not proof of the role held at the event.

institutionId.description: Institution of the recorded actor. A PRC response on this institution's request shows INST_SYNTH_PRC.

scanId.description: Confirmed inbound OCR capture ID (INCAP_) for REGISTER_INBOUND_COMPONENT and RECEIVE_INBOUND_COMPONENT; null otherwise.

transferId.description: Transfer request ID (TRF_; Request ID column) recorded on the command or linked through its reservation. Same wire meaning as transferId in /transfer-summaries and /unit-history.

reservationId.description: Reservation the command references. Shown as Transfer ID only when reservationPurpose is TRANSFER.

componentIds.description: Units the event references: its componentId, its selectedComponentIds, or the committed reservation snapshot for reservation actions. Empty when none.

prcSupplyRequestId.description: Set only on PRC_SUPPLY_COORDINATION rows; never a request, transfer, scan or ledger ID.

eventStatus.description: CONFIRMED only for COMMITTED commands. OFF_CHAIN_RECORDED for acknowledgements, which never go to the ledger and are not pending synchronization.

processingStatus.description: Raw command status; null for acknowledgements.

correlationId.description: Technical provenance; not a business ID.

coordination.description: PRC coordination transition; null on non-PRC rows.

nextCursor.description: V2 cursors are bound to V2; a V1 cursor is refused and vice versa.

BloodBankSummary.description: BLOOD_BANK_SUMMARY_V1 (ADR-046). Complete own-institution counts from the ledger projection at asOf; never a capped list. inventory.available/reserved count units whose printed label expiry is after asOf; labelExpiredPendingEvaluation counts AVAILABLE/RESERVED units whose label has expired but which have not been ledger-evaluated (not usable stock). requests.*AwaitingDecision count PENDING requests with no reservation (the ledger request stays PENDING after approval; approval records its single reservation). expiringSoon is POLICY_BLOCKED until RQ-03 approves a near-expiry threshold. Low Stock is derived by the client from SYNTHETIC_STOCK_CLASSIFICATION_V1, not served here.

incomingAwaitingDecision.description: Requests addressed to this bank as supplier.

outgoingAwaitingDecision.description: Requests this bank sent to another supplier.

NetworkAvailability.description: NETWORK_AVAILABILITY_V1 (ADR-046). Complete city-wide aggregate, per the permission matrix row 'View city-wide aggregate availability' (ROLE-01/02/03). One row per ACTIVE institution × blood type × component holding label-current AVAILABLE units at asOf; an absent combination means none recorded, not unknown. Reserved, in-transit, held and label-expired units are excluded. Not transferable supply or a redistribution approval.

RequestHistoryAggregate.description: REQUEST_HISTORY_AGGREGATE_V1 (ADR-046). Complete aggregate of recorded V2 transfer requests where the caller's institution is supplier (INCOMING) or requester (OUTGOING), grouped by Asia/Manila request date, blood type, component and urgency. requestedUnits are requested, not received or transfused. Departments are not recorded (departmentAvailability NOT_RECORDED).

OutboundVerificationRequest.description: Exact body. scannedLabels are the confirmed printed Donation No. values of every unit being prepared, each once. They are matched by keyed lookup and never stored or returned.

OutboundVerification.description: OUTBOUND_LABEL_VERIFICATION_V1 (ADR-047) server-issued preparation evidence. Pass evidenceId and evidenceDigest as preparedEvidenceId/preparedEvidenceDigest to POST /reservations/{reservationId}/prepare for the same reservationVersion. Off-chain record; ledger NOT_APPLICABLE until prepare commits.

ReceiptVerificationRequest.description: INBOUND_RECEIPT_LABEL_VERIFICATION_V1 exact body. Each scanned label pairs the confirmed printed Donation No. with the component read from the same label; both are matched by keyed lookup and never stored or returned.

ReceiptVerification.description: INBOUND_RECEIPT_LABEL_VERIFICATION_V1 (ADR-049) server-issued receipt evidence. Pass evidenceId and evidenceDigest as receiptEvidenceId/receiptEvidenceDigest to POST /reservations/{reservationId}/receive for the same reservationVersion. Off-chain record; ledger NOT_APPLICABLE until receive commits. No stock is registered.

officialPhone.description: Synthetic generic facility line; real numbers are not collected.

facilityLicenseExpiresOn.description: Calendar date; must be after the current Asia/Manila date and within 3653 days.

authorityExpiresOn.description: Calendar date; must be after the current Asia/Manila date and within 3653 days.

medicalTechnologistReference.description: Synthetic role-holder reference replacing a personal name or employee ID. Real names and staff identifiers are not collected.

medicalTechnologistLicenseReference.description: Synthetic professional-license placeholder. Real Professional Regulation Commission license numbers are not collected.

capabilityDeclarations.description: Applicant capability declaration. Never filled by Fill Up.

headOfFacilityReference.description: Synthetic role-holder reference replacing a personal name or employee ID. Real names and staff identifiers are not collected.

headOfFacilityLicenseReference.description: Synthetic professional-license placeholder. Real Professional Regulation Commission license numbers are not collected.

authorityReference.description: Blood Station ATO or transfusion-service authorization reference (synthetic).

authorityExpiresOn.description: Calendar date; must be after the current Asia/Manila date and within 3653 days.

medicalTechnologistReference.description: Synthetic role-holder reference replacing a personal name or employee ID. Real names and staff identifiers are not collected.

medicalTechnologistLicenseReference.description: Synthetic professional-license placeholder. Real Professional Regulation Commission license numbers are not collected.

capabilityDeclarations.description: Applicant capability declaration. Never filled by Fill Up.

referralFacilityName.description: Referral blood bank / supplying BSF display name.

applicantPosition.description: BLOOD_BANK_HEAD for BLOOD_BANK, FACILITY_ADMINISTRATOR for REQUESTOR.

applicantReference.description: Synthetic role-holder reference replacing a personal name or employee ID. Real names and staff identifiers are not collected.

requestedLoginEmail.description: bloodbank@ for BLOOD_BANK, facility@ for REQUESTOR. Domain equals the official email domain, optionally followed by -i<n> (n>=2) for a re-registered sample instance. Activation must provision exactly this login; the institution password and PIN are still provisioned by PRC at activation.

password.description: Applicant-status password only (scrypt verifier). Not the institution login password. Confirmation is checked client-side and not sent.

fixtureId.description: Must be the slot's synthetic fixture ID. File uploads are not accepted in V1.

PublicApplicationDocument.description: BLOOD_BANK requires HEALTH_FACILITY_LTO, BSF_LTO and BSF_ASSESSMENT_PACKAGE. REQUESTOR requires HEALTH_FACILITY_LTO and BLOOD_STATION_AUTHORIZATION; REFERRAL_AGREEMENT is optional. Stored as kind SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE with verificationStatus NOT_VERIFIED.

PublicApplicationSubmission.description: SYNTHETIC_PUBLIC_APPLICATION_V1. Every field is validated; unknown fields at any level return ONB_APPLICATION_INVALID with details. qualification follows the category: PublicBloodBankQualification or PublicRequestorQualification. When sample is set, its identity fields (facility.displayName, legalName, officialEmail, facilityLicenseReference, qualification.authorityReference, primaryAccount.requestedLoginEmail) must equal the catalog values for that instance; other fields stay editable. When sample is null, catalog identity values are reserved.

declaration.description: Final applicant attestation. Never filled by Fill Up.

SampleAvailability.description: APPLICATION_IN_PROGRESS: SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW or APPROVED but not activated. REGISTERED: activated institution not deregistered. Released only by rejection, withdrawal, deregistration, or the retention purge of an approval that was never activated (APPROVAL_LAPSED).

repeated.description: True when the excluded sample was the only eligible one.

fill.description: Present when SELECTED. Values for all four steps: category, facility (expiry dates computed from today in Asia/Manila), qualification without capabilityDeclarations, primaryAccount without password, and documents (slot fixture IDs).

notFilled.description: Always primaryAccount.password, qualification.capabilityDeclarations and declaration: the applicant generates the password locally and makes every attestation.

PolicyDisabled.description: Policy or report format is not enabled

Conflict.description: A safe identity or state conflict

Forbidden.description: The authenticated role is outside the permitted scope

CommandTimeOutOfWindow.description: V2_COMMAND_TIME_OUT_OF_WINDOW: a new command eventTime (and requestTime for transfer requests) is more than 300 seconds from the server clock. A retry with an already accepted Idempotency-Key replays the original command unchanged, and an exact operation of the active approved population manifest keeps its recorded time. On this error, discard the attempt and submit a new attempt with a new Idempotency-Key and the current time.
